## Author checklist
<!-- Complete ALL items before requesting review -->

**All submissions:**
- [ ] I have read `CONTRIBUTING.md` in full
- [ ] This PR is scoped to one service or one category batch (not mixed types)
- [ ] No proprietary, confidential, or personally identifiable data is included
- [ ] Conflict of interest is disclosed below, or I confirm there is none

**Benchmark submissions:**
- [ ] Scorecard includes: service name, exact API/spec version, primary pathway, all available pathways, agent model(s) + version(s), assessment date(s), methodology version, service tier, assessor handle
- [ ] All error messages are quoted verbatim (API keys and credentials redacted)
- [ ] Timing data includes measurement method (tool, conditions)
- [ ] Evidence supports every score assigned

**Framework changes:**
- [ ] Evidence from real agent testing supports this change
- [ ] Methodology version bump is correct (patch / minor / major — see `framework/scoring-methodology.md`)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has been updated with the change and new version

---

## Reviewer checklist
- [ ] Scores are consistent with the rubric in `framework/scoring-methodology.md`
- [ ] Category weights applied correctly per `framework/category-weights.md`
- [ ] No scoring dimension omitted or duplicated
- [ ] Evidence quality is sufficient for the tier claimed
